name: Molecular and Systems Pharmacology PhD
summary: Separate GDBBS doctoral program in molecular and systems pharmacology; first-year research rotations precede faculty affiliation.

deadlines.label: Fall 2027 application
deadlines.note: GDBBS confirms Fall 2027. Central instructions say midnight Eastern on the deadline date, while the FAQ says 11:59 p.m. Pacific; earlier central time retained. Submit before December 1.

applicationFee.note: Limited financial-hardship waivers explicitly include international applicants. Upload supporting evidence; allow five business days for review. Qualifying preparation-program waivers also offered. Hardship applicants are expected to meet the US Department of Education low-income definition.

english.toefl: 100 recommended, not a fixed minimum (published score scale unspecified)
english.note: TOEFL or IELTS for non-native English speakers, scores within two years. No IELTS minimum stated. English-medium BS/MS can waive TOEFL: automatic for US/English-speaking-country institutions; otherwise email the GDBBS admissions contact to confirm English instruction.

documents: Registrar-issued transcript copies from attended universities; translations if needed
requirements.note: Bachelor degree required; general GDBBS guidance lists B+ or better in major science courses and values research experience. Credential evaluation recommended, not required. Registrar-issued copies are the safer transcript rule where FAQ permits legible web copies. SOP recommendation: at most two double-spaced pages, not a strict limit; describe research role, interests and goals. FAQ offers an optional fourth reference; three required.

funding.note: All accepted students who enroll receive stipend, tuition scholarship and health insurance; FAQ explicitly confirms the same support for international students. No future stipend amount inferred.

sources.label: Separate applications, rotations, English and international support
